Purpose & Why It's Needed: Authenticates a user by sending their email/password. It sets an HTTP-only JWT cookie in the browser to keep them logged in across sessions.
Creates a brand new user account in your PostgreSQL database and automatically logs them in.
Clears the JWT cookie from the browser and destroys the active session, effectively logging the user out.
Fetches the current logged-in user's data (name, summary, skills, location). Used globally via the useProfile hook so any component can render the user's name.
Saves changes made to the user's profile. Called when a user completes initial onboarding or uses the Edit Profile modal on their profile page.
Retrieves the list of posts for the global feed. Called automatically when the component mounts, powering the main feed page.
Takes a FormData object (containing text and optionally an image file), uploads the image to Cloudinary, and saves the new post to the database.
Used when a user edits their post (e.g. changing text or image). This sends the updated FormData to the server to overwrite the existing post data.
Used when a user clicks Delete on their post and confirms it via the custom toast. It permanently removes the post from the database.
Toggles the like status of a post. It sends the postId to the server which either adds a like or removes a like depending on the user's current status.
Fetches all comments (including nested replies) for a specific post to display under the post.
Allows a user to post a new comment or reply to an existing comment on a post.
Retrieves the work/education experiences for a user profile.
Adds a new work or education experience to the user's profile.
Updates an existing work/education experience.
Deletes a work/education experience from a user's profile.
Searches for users in the database by name/keyword for the network/connections page.
Fetches a list of users to display as potential connections in the network tab.
Sends a connection (friend) request to another user.
Accepts or rejects a pending connection request.
Fetches all of the current user's active connections and pending requests.
Creates a new 1-on-1 chat conversation with a user, or retrieves the existing one if it already exists.
Retrieves the list of all active conversations the current user is a part of for the messaging sidebar.
Fetches the list of users inside a specific conversation room.
Fetches the chat history (all previous messages) when opening a specific conversation.
Sends a new chat message to a conversation via the REST API (works alongside Socket.IO for real-time delivery).
